verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Unity builds 3D games and offers 'the latest advances in rendering, lighting, and visual effects' for high-end interactive experiences, which points to a production 3D renderer. The pack never names the specific features the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of PBR materials, global illumination or baked lighting (lightmapping), shadow rendering, post-processing stack, render pipeline documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
